findings.description: The KMS customer managed key used for the audit bucket does not enable automatic key rotation (enable_key_rotation is unset, defaulting to false). Without rotation, the same key material protects all audit data indefinitely, so any compromise or leak of the key material exposes all past and future data and there is no cryptographic re-keying to limit the blast radius.
